call_memory.quote: A defining development was the commissioning of the new dielectric film line at Barjora, which entered commercial production on 27 March, 2026.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The new dielectric film line at Barjora entered commercial production on March 27, 2026.

lab.quote: We have started production there and we would certainly target at least 50% utilization during the year, if not more.

call_memory.quote: We have started production there and we would certainly target at least 50% utilization during the year, if not more.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company expects to achieve at least 50% capacity utilization on the recently added Barjora line during the year.

lab.quote: Barring unforeseen circumstances, commercial operations are expected later during this year.

call_points.text: Coex division volumes moderated due to a temporary slowdown in refrigerator production and early monsoon conditions.
Raw material prices and polymer costs have risen steeply following the West Asia crisis, putting upward pressure on film prices.
All outstanding warrants were fully converted during the year, allotting 11,70,000 equity shares, with unutilized QIP and preferential issue proceeds held in banks.
The Board has recommended a dividend of ₹2 per equity share on the expanded capital, subject to member approval.

timeline.summary: On May 2, 2026, Xpro India announced that shareholders approved the re-appointment of Sidharth Kumar Birla as Chairman in whole-time employment for three years.
Xpro India reported full utilization of QIP and preferential issue proceeds in its final monitoring agency report for March 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹134.37 Cr (-15.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹12.97 Cr.
Xpro India Limited announces its 29th AGM on July 20, 2026, at 10:30 AM (IST) via video conferencing; book closure from July 14–20, 2026, with July 13 as record date for dividend eligibility.
Xpro India released its Q4 FY26 press release highlighting a PAT of ₹11.6 Cr and the commissioning of the Barjora dielectric film line.
Xpro India issued a revised Q4FY26 press release reporting standalone revenue of ₹134.4 Cr and PAT of ₹11.6 Cr.

Xpro India Limited uploaded the audio recording of its earnings conference call for Q4FY26 and FY26 ended March 31, 2026, on May 22, 2026, signed by **Kamal Kishor Sewoda**, **KAMAL DigitallyKAMAL KISHOR**.
On May 27, 2026, Xpro India published the postal ballot results showing shareholder approval for the re-appointment of Sidharth Kumar Birla as Chairman.
On May 22, 2026, Xpro India held its Q4 and FY26 earnings call, discussing the commissioning of the Barjora dielectric line and leadership succession.
